items.reason: A lower-strength retinol is a sensible place to start for the look of fine lines, and it suits a first-time user.
Retinol can make skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 protects the skin and helps keep results looking their best.
Your scan shows low moisture appearance, and a ceramide moisturizer helps keep skin comfortable while it adjusts to retinol.

response.routine_note: Apply the retinol at night to dry skin, 2 nights a week at first, then add nights slowly as skin feels comfortable, and follow with moisturizer. Use sunscreen every morning, and pause the retinol if skin feels stinging or very dry.
